qa_pairs.question: What kind of statistics are available in the "Ordonnancement" tab of the Metrix Portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The "Ordonnancement" tab in the Metrix Portal provides statistics on the allocated CPU cores and GPUs of the cluster.

qa_pairs.question: What are the available visualization timeframes for the statistics presented in the "Ordonnancement" tab of the Metrix Portal?
qa_pairs.answer: For the statistics in the "Ordonnancement" tab of the Metrix Portal, users can view data from the last week, the last day, or the last hour.
